+    ops = [o for o in SequenceMatcher(None, r, p, autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if o[0] != "equal"]
+    if not ops:
+        return lock
+    tag = f"{lock['video_id']} words {lock['i0']}-{lock['i1']}"
+    diffs = [[" ".join(r[a:b]), " ".join(p[c:d])] for _, a, b, c, d in ops]

+    sw, usd = (recognise or _second_recogniser_words)(src_path)

+    s = canon.canon_tokens(sec_t)

+    def cover(x, y):                                   # indices of x that the alignment with y reads the same
+        return {i for op, a, b, _, _ in SequenceMatcher(None, x, y, autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if op == "equal"
+                for i in range(a, b)}
+    in_p, in_r = cover(p, s), cover(r, s)
+    side = lambda xs, ys, cx, cy: all(i in cx for i in xs) and not any(j in cy for j in ys)
